scope: New internal query-family study of candidate coverage and nonlearned C1 reference scoring; not external or laboratory replication; no fitting of supervised weights.
protection: Authenticate original input hashes; reconstruct advanced 600/150/250 and purged 300/100/150 partitions and original 150 external family selection with matching published digests before selecting any new queries. Exclude every selected prior family/group/metric and historical V-in family. Union metric-linked eligible family components before selection; drop any component touching a protected family or metric.
selection: Hash-order remaining family components by salt, lexical-key representative; first 100 development and next 300 test. Up to five spectra per query using fixed key-derived sampling. No candidate/outcome-based eligibility or replacement.
candidate_policy: Same verified pool, fresh D2 index and per-query C3 metric truth reference/candidate exclusion. Keep union of legacy, expanded and extended proposals for extended; preserve prior policy candidates explicitly. No learned scores or NP-score.
primary: Test C3 binary truth coverage: extended minus expanded, paired 4000-draw percentile 95% interval; all 300 molecules remain in denominator.
uncertainty: 4000 molecule-paired bootstrap draws; secondary fixed-family max-deviation intervals. Report absolute coverage, C1 MRR/top1/top10/hit25, counts, candidate costs and every loss.
development: Recommend extended only if development has at least one coverage gain and zero losses versus expanded. Freeze recommendation and population digests before test. All policies always reported regardless of choice.
baseline: C1 D1 entropy versus optimal-assignment raw-intensity cosine at 0.02 Da, common source-library metric exclusions, same mass candidates and same cleaning, mass-error tie breaking, metric-deduplicated top25. This comparison is C1 because a direct-reference scorer is structurally limited under C2/C3 truth-reference removal.
budget: Existing free Kaggle CPU only, internet disabled, no pretrained weights, no paid services, no submission/deployment.
failure_policy: Preserve sources and failures; fail closed if input/protected population reconstruction or source integrity differs. No sample/budget change after candidate or score inspection. Implementation repair requires a preserved, explicitly documented new attempt.
unresolved: Does not resolve learned D3/NP-score incremental effects, prove state-of-the-art superiority or establish laboratory replication.
